player_id: Stable MLB person ID; primary join key.
player_name: Name reported by MLB at retrieval.
team_id: MLB team ID; franchise continuity may span names.
team_name: Team name from the season-specific teams endpoint.
position_reported: Position abbreviation reported in the pitching response; not guaranteed historically time-specific.
age: Age reported in the season statistical split.
outs: Exact recorded outs; canonical additive workload measure.
innings_display: Baseball notation: 6.2 means six innings and two outs, not 6.2 decimal innings.
walks: All bases on balls, including intentional walks.
intentional_walks: Intentional walks; already included in walks.
source_url: Exact team-season query used for this record.
role: starter if starts/games >= 0.5; reliever if starts=0; mixed otherwise.
sample_flag: Workload category: zero_outs, under_10_IP, 10_to_39_IP (10 <= IP < 40), or 40_plus_IP.
fip: Calculated annual-baseline FIP; see README formula.
fip_constant: Annual additive constant that aligns aggregate FIP to MLB ERA.
league_era: Combined MLB annual ERA, including position-player pitching.
performance_index: Custom descriptive index, 100=MLB average, higher better. See README.
rating_sample_weight: IP/(IP+40); shrinkage weight, not a statistical confidence probability.
weighted_performance_index: Outs-weighted mean of underlying season or team-season performance indexes.
latest_observed_performance_index: Index from latest observed season in this window.
latest_observed_role: Role from latest observed season in this window.
best_season_by_index: Year of highest nonblank season index; no extra innings qualification.
first_observed_season: Earliest appearance year inside the requested window.
last_observed_season: Latest appearance year inside the requested window.
seasons_with_appearances: Distinct years containing MLB pitching appearances.
boundary_start: True if earliest observed year equals the requested start year.
boundary_end: True if latest observed year equals the requested end year.
observed_run_number: Chronological run number within player/team; gaps in appearance years split runs.
team_count: Distinct team IDs within the row scope.
team_ids: Semicolon-separated team IDs; sequence does not indicate chronological assignment.
teams: Team names (or team count in validation.csv); no within-season order implied.
team_names_observed: Unique names observed for this team ID during row scope.
league: MLB team league name for the season.
division: MLB team division name for the season.
pitchers: Unique players with pitching appearances in the validation season.
pitcher_team_rows: Number of team-season pitching records in the validation season.
player_totals_reconcile: True only after all 14 specified counting fields match independently fetched player-season totals.
